lines.text: Sorry! Sorry! I ran. I always run. No change!
Strawberry? From our farm. Just past the fence.
Fast. …Strawberry?
Strawberry? We counted five.
Then we heard another engine. Behind them. Clear.
And then we… didn't.
And you were just standing there.
Strawberry? No. Later. Water first.
Senator! That's the road to the VC's roses!
I met every bus! I brought everybody strawberry!
Strawberry? No. Tractor. I'll get the tractor!
Agriculture. Senator sends his regards. And a strawberry.
Hi! Sorry! I ran! I always run! Strawberry?
Morning! I've been up since five. The cows don't do lie-ins.
Oh, hello! Hold this. No, the basket. Thank you. Hi!
Sannu! [Hello!] You look sad. Here. Strawberry.
Bye! I have to run. The tractor is waiting. Tractors don't wait.
Go! Eat something red today. Doctor's orders. I'm not a doctor.
Thank you! Here, take two. No, three. Okay, the basket.
Sorry! Sorry! My basket hit you. It's heavy. It's love.
You look so healthy! Like a strawberry in the right season.
You can carry a sack! Can you also drive a tractor? No? Soon!
You've never seen a farm before? Look. That's a cow. It's looking at you.
You call that running? I run with a basket on my head.
Come, come! Faster! The shuttle leaves at four, and it means four-ish!
Faster! The cows have been waiting since six! So have I!
Hurry! The strawberries are ripening while we stand here!
That's the road to Agriculture. Keep going past the cows. The cows know.
Yes! Yes! Strawberry?
No. But here. Strawberry.
Maybe. Ask me after harvest.
Wait, what? Say it slower. I'm breathing.
Who? There was nobody there fa. Just Senator. He's a ram.
Exactly! That's what I told the Dean! He said 'later'!
No, I can't. But take this strawberry so you're not sad about it.
Why did the strawberry cry? It was in a jam! Sorry. My father's joke.
Have you eaten? You haven't. Strawberry. Then go to Mama Nkechi.
We won! Strawberries for everyone! Within reason!
We lost. Strawberry?
Strawberry? It doesn't fix it. It helps.
Oh! Sorry! Was that the basket or me? The basket. Probably.
I'm fine! I've fallen off worse. Like a tractor.
NEPA again. At the farm we don't notice. We go to bed with the chickens.
Light! Quick, the cold room! The strawberries!
Rain! Finally! The farm is dancing! I'm dancing!
Too hot. Strawberries hate this. So do I. Shade.
Mama Nkechi gives me rice. I give her strawberries. Best trade on campus.
I made forty naira profit this week. I gave away the rest. Again.
For me? Oh, thank you! I'll put it on the tractor! For luck!
Oh. Thank you. I'll… give it to someone sad. That's what I do.
Seeds! Proper seeds! You remembered! I'm going to cry on them!
Basket. Phone. Notes. Basket. Where's my other basket?
Senator! Get back here! Sorry. That's the ram. He's having a day.
At night the fields are so quiet. You hear everything. Even strawberries.
Remember the fruit? You were the delivery rider! I paid you in strawberries!
Your helmet was on backwards. Zainab told you. I told you too. Twice.
Farm to market, market to farm. First years look at me like I'm a horse.
The long road to New Site has no lights. Somebody should fix that.
Hi! You don't know me yet. I'm the girl with the basket. Take one!
Harmattan. The farm's all dust. The strawberries are sulking under cloth.
Rain coming! Lily said so! Lily is always right!
Freshers! You all look so lost. Like goats at a party.
You said thank you to the shuttle driver. Nobody does that. Strawberry.
Want to see the farm? It's just past the fence. Then the next fence.
Hi! It's you! The rider! Strawberry?
New Site has no water. Three days. The strawberries have more water than us.
Emeka calls me 'the strawberry girl'. I've stopped correcting him.
Five kekes of water through the first rain. Iya Risi still talks about it.
You brought water to New Site! In the rain! You're a hero! Strawberry!
You drove the okada into a moot court. Lyzzy got it on video.
You don't panic. That's rare. Panic is my whole personality.
First rain! Run! No, stay! Run!
You came! The farm needs hands! Strawberry? No. Later. Water first.
The students left. The animals didn't. The animals never strike.
Senator is out AGAIN. He's heading for the VC's roses!
Your first tractor! You only hit one fence! A small fence!
Senator's bell. Six dots and one in the middle. The Dean never asked why.
I'll get the tractor! That night by the forest! I still have the mud!
Strike month five. The farm's never had so many friends. Thank you.
You picked the strawberries so gently. You're a farmer now. Sorry.
Driest year yet. I'm carrying water to the beds at dawn. You can help. Please?
Market day's coming! Strawberries, jam, juice, and a sign Aleeya painted!
Somebody wants to buy our land. Dad said no. Nicely. Then twice.
Lily's doing the greenhouse. I'm doing the field. Together we're a farm.
I met every bus! I brought everybody strawberries!
You're famous now. Even the cows have heard. They're unimpressed.
You stuck by your friends after that clip. That's farm loyalty.
Market stall! Sold out by noon! Gave the rest away by one!
Rain on the farm in final year! It came for my last harvest! I'm crying!
Final year! The farm's safe! I'm crying! Strawberry?
Senator sends his regards. And a strawberry. Mostly he sends a smell.
Dad signed the paper. The farm stays. Forever. Or till the next crisis.
Agriculture's seal. Senator behaved. Almost.
You'll be fine out there. You've driven a tractor. Everything else is easier.
Come and visit after convocation. Bring a basket. Leave with two.
You still can't tell a strawberry flower from a weed. Five years!
Freshers! Free strawberries for everybody who looks lost! So everybody!
Exam week. Soil Science. I'm reading in the barn. The cows are helping.
Results are out! I passed! Strawberry? For me this time!
Allowance! I spent it on fertiliser. That's romance at the farm.
Cup final! I brought snacks! For both teams! Is that allowed?
Who's promising to fix the New Site road? I'll vote for whoever means it.
Convocation! I brought strawberries for everyone in a gown. Two each.
Iftar basket! Dates, water, and strawberries. Don't argue. It's tradition now.
Christmas. The farm doesn't close. Dad says the strawberries don't know.
Valentine's. Strawberries are expensive this week. I'm still giving them away.
Harmattan. Cover the beds. Drink water. Hug a cow. Cows are warm.
